::: {.section-label}
Background & Goals
:::

Analytical mind, *curious by nature*

I'm a Dublin-based graduate with a **BA in Economics & Politics (Joint Honours)** from University College Dublin, and I'm currently completing an **MSc in Business Analytics** at Dublin City University. My academic journey started at Trinity College Dublin, where I studied Business, Economic & Social Studies before transferring to UCD.

My interests sit at the intersection of data, technology, and security. I'm drawn to problems that require both analytical rigour and creative thinking — whether that's building a data pipeline, researching a cybersecurity incident, or communicating findings clearly to a non-technical audience.

Alongside my studies, I work part-time as a security officer, which has given me a strong foundation in situational awareness, protocols, and calm decision-making under pressure.
